questions.question: What is a leader? Name three places where we find leaders.
questions.expected_answer: A leader is a person who guides a group of people towards a goal. We find leaders at home, such as parents; at school, such as principals, teachers and class captains; in the community, such as chiefs and religious leaders; and in the country, such as the President.

questions.question: Explain three ways people become leaders.
questions.expected_answer: Some are born into leadership, such as a king or chief who inherits it. Some are elected by a vote, such as a class captain or a councillor. Some are appointed by someone in charge, such as a principal. Some become leaders by standing up to act against a problem.

questions.question: Why is a good leader not just a boss who gives orders?
questions.expected_answer: A good leader works for the good of the whole group, not only for themselves. A good leader listens, is fair and honest, and works with others, instead of only shouting orders.
